parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: A cabinet door made of MDF, rectangular in shape, part of the front enclosure of the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It allows access to the storage compartment by opening and closing.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about a hinge axis to open or close.

parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: A lower cabinet door made of MDF, part of the front enclosure of the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It provides access to the lower storage compartment.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about a hinge axis to open or close.

parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: A middle cabinet door made of MDF, part of the front enclosure of the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It allows access to the middle storage section.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about a hinge axis to open or close.

parts.name: Cabinet Door

parts.name: Cabinet Door

parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: The main structural frame of the cabinet made of plywood, enclosing all shelves and doors.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural support and defines the overall shape of the cabinet.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving structural component.

parts.name: Shelf
parts.Basic_description: A horizontal shelf made of particle board, located at the bottom of the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It supports stored items within the cabinet.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move.

parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move.
